checks.rationale: Verify the sibling stored-reference validator continues to reject outside-root, changed-byte, and symlink references on both revisions.
covers: Stored document references remain private direct children with matching bytes.

checks.rationale: Prove the harness and normal private-file reuse path work on both pinned revisions.
covers: A service-owned 0700 directory containing a matching 0600 regular file is accepted.

checks.rationale: Run the complete repository verifier on the patched revision, including disposable PostgreSQL integration, migration/restore, runtime-role, queue-recovery and claim-concurrency checks.
covers: All repository tests and disposable integration verification pass.

checks.rationale: Exercise the sibling stranded-file reuse caller directly, with the root already replaced by a symlink before the helper begins; this path does not receive the earlier root preflight.
covers: Orphan reuse rejects an already-symlinked parent root instead of accepting a matching external file.

checks.rationale: Preserve successful matching-file reuse and stable symlink rejection with byte-identical aggregate output.
covers: Normal reuse result and symlink safety output remain unchanged.

checks.rationale: Reproduce replacement of the configured root with a symlink after root lstat but before the child is resolved; outside bytes have the expected digest.
covers: The validator must not accept a matching file reached through a root symlink introduced during validation.

checks.rationale: Exercise established secure orphan reuse on both revisions without depending on the new race regression test.
covers: Matching private orphan reuse remains functional.

finding.summary: Document reference validation checked the private storage root by pathname, then reopened a child by pathname; replacing the root with a symlink between checks could make the service accept/read a matching file outside the configured root.
